Risk: Offensive language generation in language model outputs
Problem analysis: Inadequate manual red-teaming coverage in language model safety testing
Theoretical insight: Automated adversarial prompt generation increases harmful behavior discovery in language models
Design rationale: Using language models as red teamers to simulate malicious users during testing
Implementation mechanism: Training adversarial language model with prompt engineering for diverse harmful prompts
Validation evidence: Increased test case coverage and discovery of multiple harm categories in experiments
Intervention: Train adversarial language model to generate harmful prompts for red teaming during pre-deployment testing
